method.input_scope: Only source_metadata.json and quote_gaps.csv.gz; no price/raw-candle reads or downloads.
method.missing_interval: [previous observed quote + 1 minute, next observed quote); intersect with each UTC period before summing.
method.large_gap: Full gap missing_minutes >= 120. Window totals clip boundary-crossing gaps, avoiding double counting.
method.usual_weekend_shape_hint: Previous quote Friday UTC hour 20 or 21; next quote Sunday UTC hour 22 or 23; full missing_minutes between 2820 and 3010 inclusive. Heuristic grouping only, not an accepted calendar mask.
method.intraday_diagnostic: Both endpoints on the same UTC weekday, missing interval begins at hour >=1, next quote hour <=21, and >=60 absent minutes. A descriptive subset, not an official open-market calendar.
method.holiday_candidates: Date-based hints, unverified against the unnamed source execution venue; not sufficient to exclude a data gap from audit.

development_2023.annual_comparison_limitation: Row difference is not an exact missing-trading-minute estimate; year-specific weekdays and holidays differ.

findings: 2023 has no week-long or month-long continuous outage; repeated intraday holes are the material problem. The diagnostic subset finds 499 gaps totaling 33,848 absent minutes, concentrated January-July, particularly February-July.
2023 contains 308,752 observed rows, 45,816 fewer than 2022 (about 12.92%). The annual difference is not itself a calendar-adjusted estimate of lost trading minutes.

Selection contains unexplained early-Friday endpoints on 2024-01-12 (17:59 UTC) and 2025-12-05 (15:59 UTC), a 65-minute gap on 2024-10-10 00:06-01:11 UTC, and an extended 120-minute daily gap on 2025-10-21 22:00-24:00 UTC. The source weekend/daily flags must not hide these cases.

Confirmation January-May 2026 has no repeated daytime >=60-minute gap pattern like 2023 and no non-usual-weekend large gap beyond five holiday-date candidates. This audit does not prove complete source coverage.

The 2023 gaps compromise any 2023 return replay and indicators within that period. Selection gaps may alter signals, execution or stop/trailing observations; trade-ledger overlap was not inspected and PnL impact is unknown.
limitations: Absent calendar minutes include weekends, daily closures and holidays; the totals are not counts of proven missing tradeable minutes.
HistData identifies BID quotes but not the execution venue; no authoritative venue-specific historical session calendar is available in these inputs.
No duplicate conflicts and valid OHLC establish structural integrity, not temporal completeness.
No OHLC values, strategies, positions or returns were read; this audit cannot quantify economic bias.
No gaps were filled, deleted, reclassified as guaranteed valid, or used to select trading rules.
